region: Gale Crater / Aeolis Mons demonstration corridor

layers.label: MOLA topography
layers.caveat: Regional DEM; not a rover-scale obstacle guarantee.

layers.label: HiRISE Gale DTM browse
layers.caveat: Color-altimetry browse derivative at approximately 1.01 m/pixel. The numeric 833 MB DTM is not bundled; this image is context-only until map registration is implemented.

layers.label: MSL PLACES rover localization
layers.caveat: Official localized/interpolated Curiosity positions are the next point-observation adapter; they must be joined using the PDS coordinate and map metadata.

layers.label: MSL weather context
layers.caveat: Gale station observations; not a spatial dust-front raster.

layers.label: MSL RAD radiation
layers.caveat: RAD is a time series at the Curiosity location. It is not valid to interpolate across Mount Sharp without a physical model.

layers.label: REMS / Mars Climate Database
layers.caveat: Weather context is temporal and station/model based; it is not a live spatial dust hazard map.

layers.label: InSight SEIS quake catalog
layers.caveat: InSight is in Elysium Planitia, not Gale Crater. Events cannot be labeled as local Mount Sharp hazards.

layers.label: MSL APXS / ChemCam / CheMin / SAM
layers.caveat: Chemistry is measured at discrete rover targets, not as a continuous route raster.

layers.label: CRISM / USGS geology
layers.caveat: Orbital observations have nonuniform footprints and require product-specific map projection.
